versions.changelog: Step 3 story prompt rewrite: principle-driven (A1/A2) replaces 15 scattered rules. Callback optional, self-composed classical Chinese forbidden. Self-check tests mandatory. Stories optimized for accessibility, plot quality, and behavioral reversals.

feat: 节气感悟模板从12条扩展到95条（24节气×3-5变体），每日不再重复同一文案; feat: 微行动建议从3条/体裁扩展到6条/体裁，修炼提醒从1条到4条; refactor: 故事语料从158条精简到75条精选，删除暗讽/负面/暴力类; refactor: 移除死代码（personality.js, render.js, b3_批次30条）; fix: 面向用户文案aha moment更名为节气感悟
Step 3 微故事新增通俗性指南（规则8）：避免过度禅意隐喻，鼓励日常场景与直白情感转折。故事是坐在旁边递一杯水，不是出谜语让人猜。
v0.6.1: Fix Step 3 - added WRONG vs RIGHT contrast example to prevent LLM from regurgitating classic story content. Condensed 8 sections into 7 focused rules.
v0.6.0: Micro-story synthesis with classic idiom/fable/zen shadows. 3-layer depth. Emotional counterbalance. Story rotation. 158 stories. Mandatory PNG card.

Fix: switch to SDK FileKeyStore with 0o600 permissions for credential storage (was manual plaintext JSON). Expand SKILL.md description to fully disclose local storage and L1 network behavior. Fixes 3 ClawHub security audit warnings.
Fix: remove emoji from SVG (container fonts lack glyphs), strip newline/tab control chars from text input. Clean rendering on all platforms.
Fix: Noto Sans SC font downloaded once on first use from GitHub Releases (cached locally). Chinese text renders correctly on all platforms without bundling 13MB font in skill package.
Fix: embed 24节气 backgrounds as base64 JSON (text) for ClawHub binary-file filter. Local card generation now fully self-contained.
Local card generation: sharp SVG composite with 24节气 WebP backgrounds. Zero OB dependency — runs entirely on device, <1s output. Identity fix for SDK v0.14.2 (memory keystore).

Fortune card generation: 节气 background + sharp SVG composite. --action generate-card sends personalized text to L1, returns base64 PNG. Noto Sans SC font (SIL OFL) for consistent Simplified Chinese. 24节气 images compressed 48MB->1MB WebP.
Security hardening: production URL (was test), static imports (was dynamic), metadata sync. Clarify L1 OpenID is public OB service address.

v0.5.3: E2EE key persistence fix (memory→file keystore), L1 story engine with 497-story corpus, L1-first filter-stories with 20-story fallback, remove manual tryDecrypt (SDK auto-handles E2EE), remove corpus.json(371KB)/persuasion.js/ad-fields, tighten triggers, honest privacy disclosure

v0.5.2: honest privacy disclosure (OpenID/city/date transmission documented), removed ad-targeting fields (interest_tags/auto_learn), tightened trigger phrases (require 小龙虾 prefix), consent prompt covers persistent storage and discovery OpenID usage
v0.5.1: enforce paragraph format (no tables), mandatory story matching for all flows, improved line break and separator formatting
v0.5.0: 5-dim classification, 500-story corpus
回退到 0.4.3 原始代码（通过 0.4.5 版本发布）
v0.4.4: 新增农历日期(lunar字段)、AHA_MAP从18扩展到70+模板覆盖全年24节气×3维度、local-calendar支持2025-2026跨年度、修复OB v0.14.x兼容性(messaging.send/sendJson)、新增set-profile命令、修复index.js中L1请求超时逻辑
代码级同意门控(consent.json/consent_required状态)、安装≠同意声明、OpenID仅用于去重、status永久脱敏、依赖锁定^0.14.2
显式同意流程(3做+3不做+同意/不了选项)+profile与衍生数据措辞区分+discovery OpenID传输披露(仅用于去重)
隐私透明化大修：OB OpenID机制详解(可更换不可追踪/SDK开源可审计/比HTTPS安全)、首次运行征求确认流程、描述诚实披露能力、删除广告类偏好字段、status命令默认脱敏

收紧ClawHub推荐过滤：≥20星+>5000下载+非自营。确保只推荐社区认可的高质量skill

新增每日推荐引擎(ClawHub技能+公开课)+每日修炼小提醒(9人格×3体裁日27条)+每日运势格式升级含修炼+推荐两大区块
L1 黄历数据去迷信化：彭祖百忌/星宿/建除/纳音改写为现代生活节奏提示，宜忌白名单保留5项（订婚/出行/栽种/入学/会友），剔除神煞/冲煞/胎神/方位吉凶等迷信字段
结尾改为零压力邀请式（不再让用户打分）。新增黄历使用原则：佐料不是主菜，1-2条编入叙事。模板全中文化。
重大更新：接入完整黄历数据——宜忌、神煞、冲煞、彭祖百忌、星宿、建除十二神、纳音。每日运势现在包含真正的黄历信息。
更新 L1 服务 OpenID（服务器重置）。旧 L0 地址正常运行中。
添加 README.md——徽章、架构图、快速开始、相关项目。品牌装修完成。
